markscheme.html:
A

The process Z→X is isovolumetric. For the cycle to be consistent, X→Y must be an isothermal expansion and Y→Z must be an adiabatic compression. During the adiabatic compression Y→Z, work is done on the gas, so the work done by the gas is negative. Since the process is adiabatic (Q=0), the change in internal energy is ΔU = -W, which is positive. Alternatively, temperature increases during adiabatic compression, so internal energy increases.
